Lesson 13.3 · 52 of 78 · 24 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Data, rules, lineage and migration

After this lesson you can:
  • Write a field-level data contract
  • Separate source facts from derived decisions
  • Design migration and reconciliation

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. Data dictionary that can execute
  2. Derived data and rules
  3. Migration
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. Data dictionary that can execute

For each field define business meaning, type/unit, owner, source, allowed values, sensitivity, validation, effective time, null semantics, retention and downstream uses. Money needs currency and precision; ratios need numerator and denominator.

2. Derived data and rules

Document formula, input provenance, version, rounding and error outcome.

A decision output is not a source fact.

Map each report, KFS field and policy input back to authoritative data and retain the transformation lineage.

3. Migration

Profile source quality; map values and states; define cutover, freeze, rejects and rollback; reconcile counts and money by control totals; sample evidence; preserve legacy identifiers and history. Never convert unknown to a permissive default.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-IT-GRC — Requirements, change and test evidence must support controlled, auditable processing.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability RPT-001 — Report lineage.
  • Capability ACC-013 — Financial reconciliation.
  • Capability PLT-011 — Controlled reload/import.

Retrieval practice

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. How should an unknown migrated approval status map?

  1. Approved
  2. The restrictive unresolved state with repair ownership
  3. Randomly by balance
  4. Newest status
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Unknown regulated state cannot become permissive through migration.
